name: sathvik-photography
description: Deployment root for Vercel — the actual app is the static frontend at the repo root and the API in server/. This file exists only so Vercel runs an install step at all (a project with zero root package.json skips dependency installation entirely, even with a custom installCommand). api/index.ts imports server/src, so server's runtime dependencies are listed here too; Node resolves them by walking up from server/src to this root's node_modules. server/package.json (with its own node_modules) remains the source of truth for local dev — this list is kept in sync with it by hand.
